name: Overvoltage
summary: A function responding to voltage above its configured operating criteria.
description: An overvoltage function detects a voltage condition above its configured criteria. The full designation and manufacturer information identify the measured quantity, implementation and application. A generic 59 reference does not establish trip values or time delays.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify the voltage measurement and full function suffix.
Read whether the configured result is an alarm, trip or other control action.
drawingChecklist: Link the operating logic and settings documentation.
distinction: A phase overvoltage element and a residual-voltage or neutral-displacement application may use different measurements and suffixes.
